goal: Operationalize all nine reopening contracts at field level without scoring readiness, assuming a source exists, or treating partial coverage as evidence that a trigger fired.
publication_rule: Publish only field-coverage, intake-control, and exception-resolution records; preserve all nine outcome holds until one complete eligible evidence package clears every field and human review approves publication.
authority_rule: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak classifies all 12 required reopening-contract fields
records.finding: 2 Amtrak contracts contain 12 required fields, each assigned exactly one explicit coverage state.
records.denominator: 2 contracts and 12 required fields.
evidence_limits: Coverage is not readiness.
A present field cannot be carried into another record.
Partial coverage cannot fire a trigger.
records.next_action: Evaluate only one complete source-explicit candidate package against the same field matrix.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak retains 1 present fields and 11 explicit blockers
records.finding: The Amtrak matrix contains 7 absent, 2 incompatible, 2 period mismatched, 1 present; none of the counts is a readiness or likelihood score.
records.denominator: 12 required field classifications.
evidence_limits: Missing does not mean nonexistent or withheld.
Blocker counts are not performance measures.
Authority and period mismatches remain separate.
records.next_action: Resolve each field through its named playbook action without changing the denominator.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak defines 2 first-eligible-record intake queues
records.finding: Each Amtrak contract now names its candidate record type, source authority, identity, period, privacy, acceptance boundaries, and disqualifiers.
records.denominator: 2 intake queues and zero accepted eligible records.
evidence_limits: A queue definition is not evidence that a candidate exists.
Sequence is not priority or readiness.
Partial matches remain non-triggering.
records.next_action: Admit only a source-explicit package that supplies every contract field under one compatible envelope.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak assigns one human-reviewed resolution action to every required field
records.finding: 12 field actions distinguish absent, incompatible, authority-mismatched, period-mismatched, privacy-gated, not-yet-evaluated, and present states without automated closure.
records.denominator: 12 field actions across 2 playbooks.
evidence_limits: No action closes a field automatically.
Values cannot migrate across records.
Human publication review remains mandatory.
records.next_action: Apply the exact action only when a candidate record enters the corresponding queue.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN control classifications, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak accepts zero eligible records and fires zero reopening triggers
records.finding: Field classification, queue construction, and exception playbooks improve auditability but do not supply a complete eligible record or change any held outcome.
records.denominator: 2 contracts, 12 fields, 2 queues, and zero trigger events.
evidence_limits: Operationalizing a contract is not satisfying it.
No operating outcome is inferred.

records.next_action: Keep every hold closed until all fields clear in one evidence package and human review approves publication.
